scope: Read-only implementation/branch audit and self-contained probes. This record does not claim complete migration, fresh full benchmark proofs, RTL equivalence, or branch proof-library rebuilds.

actual_projection_checkout.pin_policy: The shared base is a semantic reference, not a moving tracking target; explicit equivalent-preserving migration required.

patch_map_reproduction.scope: Self-contained fake source and a copied current script; no sibling benchmark access.

queue_acceptance_reproduction.scope: Self-contained copied current queue with local fake tools, no actual proof claimed.

source_only_export.static_gate_would_fail: n_nod > 0 required by run_coreet_module_lean.sh; current emitted source-only DesignCert has zero nodes.

restored_artifact_coverage.qualification: Matching artifact hashes in historical logs do not substitute for a complete proof with current matching library/toolchain. Four RUNNING dispositions are stale, not active jobs.

shl_runtime.lean.source:
import LeanSemanticPrimitives.Compiler.CompileDesign
open Compiler
def D : DesignCert := { sources := #[.const 8 1, .const 64 8589934576], nodes := #[{ op := .Op_SHL, width := 8, deps := #[0, 1], origin := 1 }], outputs := #[{ slot := 2, width := 8 }], flops := #[], memories := #[] }
#eval compilesOk D
#eval bv_uint ((compileAndRun D #[] default).outputs[0]!)

validation.bazel: Three Lean test targets passed (cached); optimized lhd executable built. Native regression suite was not rerun in this audit.
validation.shell: bash -n passed: scripts/run_coreet_module_lean.sh, scripts/coreet_filelist.sh, scripts/run_lean_queue.sh, pass/lean/scripts/hotmux_oracle.sh.
validation.discarded_attempts: A low address-space limit prevented Lean thread creation; malformed initial hand-written fixtures were corrected. A signed-Div verified evaluation is not accepted because the generated compilation theorem fails. Those harness failures are not proof results.
validation.probes_environment: Project Lean 4.31.0 and existing support artifacts; constructor declarations additionally checked with installed Lean 4.34.1. No project toolchain pins changed.
validation.limits: Large source-branch theorem suites and complete DINO/CORE-ET/CVA6 proofs were not rerun during this audit.
validation.record_checks: Audit JSON counts and commit hashes, private-path exclusion, local Markdown links and git diff --check passed.

findings.title: Branch coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: D2/D3/D4 contributions, actual Futamura checkout, CE probes and geometry work are not fully on master. Branch ancestry alone is not a preservation test.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Inventory every contribution by logical source, source commit and current destination/disposition; preserve intentional supersessions and validate every adapted implementation.

findings.title: Clock domains are scanned but not certified
findings.evidence: Fresh two-clock export typechecks and commits both flops; no edge vector/domain metadata can express firing only one clock. Generic correctness proves agreement with the clockless interpreter.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Port D2 ClockDesc, flop clock/asyncReset, memory clock, edge rules and DirectCheck. Decide a guard or explicit all-domains-fire contract until complete; require backward-compatible allEdges proofs and async-reset/memory edge tests.

findings.title: D3/D4 bounded-amount repairs absent
findings.evidence: SHL certificate compilesOk is true, then large-amount evaluation panics; SRA and Sext primitive probes also panic. Source branch repairs include eager-equivalence proofs.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Port one consistent guarded SHL/SRA/Sext implementation and reprove pointwise equivalence across eval, denote and residual; run zero/boundary/huge-amount and original branch runtime gates.

findings.title: Tail-recursive slot construction absent
findings.evidence: slotsFrom 108666 succeeds under #eval but overflows via lean --run at an 8192 KiB main-thread stack. D4 has an accumulator implementation and equality proof.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Port slotsFrom accumulator with range equality and unchanged public theorems; run the main-thread and full large runtime-certificate gates at recorded stack limits.

findings.title: D4 includes C++ transport and a proved Lean roundtrip
findings.evidence: D4 has total parseCert, pure renderCert, parse/render roundtrip, C++ DCERT1 serializer and staged pair publication. DCERT1 omits D2 clock/async metadata.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Port serializer as a CertificateIR consumer; choose versioned clock-aware format or explicit refusal. Prove new schema roundtrip and C++/Lean parity. Preserve rollback tests; do not describe a two-file pair as crash-atomic.

findings.title: Local projection ref is stale
findings.evidence: Actual independent projection checkout has 67 files including 38 Lean modules, all absent, pinned to D2 semantic base 90583be1 with a proved SHL overlay.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Use actual checkout commit; explicitly migrate the fixed semantic pin and preserve overlay equalities. Rebuild all projection modules and theorem audits without introducing compiler dependence into the independent correctness path.

findings.title: Restored flat proof coverage has 13 gaps
findings.evidence: 328 of 341 current artifact hashes match historical successful logs; 13 do not. Four old RUNNING rows have no active jobs. Nested proofs do not validate flat artifacts.
findings.required_validation_or_action: After user-owned matching Lean/Mathlib upgrade, rebuild exact imports and replay all current artifacts with wall/RSS and whole theorem/axiom audits. Measure actual record fields and execution boundaries; no nesting workaround.

findings.title: CORE-ET runner invokes retired native LEC option
findings.evidence: formal.strict causes current lhd lec usage exit 2; runner treats nonzero LEC outcomes as nonfatal even with strict requested.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Repair runner invocation/classification only: remove retired option, classify native PROVEN/REFUTED/UNKNOWN/usage/infrastructure separately and fail required gates. Preserve native checker and proof procedure.

findings.title: Patch-map existence is insufficient
findings.evidence: Copied current filelist script accepts a map for another checkout and silently selects original unpatched sources.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Validate logical input root, source hashes, required substitutions and derived hashes. Record two declaration moves and two output-logic insertions separately. Keep 122-module triage separate from the 125-configuration matrix.

findings.title: Queue accepts unrelated theorem and unknown axiom
findings.evidence: A copied queue with fake tools reports PROVEN for an unrelated theorem depending on untrusted_axiom; sequential next/step audits can be absent when expected count is derived only from emitted print lines.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Require exact expected theorem identities and required comb/next/step/chunk/global-WF audits independent of print count; allow only documented trusted axioms/native_decide facts. Add positive and negative acceptance controls.

findings.title: Source-only certificates rejected by static gate
findings.evidence: Fresh constant-output export has one source and zero nodes; Lean typecheck is valid but CORE-ET runner requires a positive node count.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Accept structurally valid empty node arrays, retain full certificate/compile correctness gates and add source-only/empty-graph positive controls.

findings.title: Signed Div exported as UDiv
findings.evidence: Legacy signed -32 / 3 evaluates to 74; verified export uses UDiv but generated compiles theorem fails because division is unsupported by CompileOp. Native encoder chooses signedness from operands, not simply result signedness.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Bring signed division behavior to user before changing semantics; add SDiv plumbing and operand-width/sign oracles only with approval. Approved Rem policy remains constant nonzero divisors only, with signed semantics separately proved.

findings.title: Hotmux lowering lacks export-local one-hot provenance
findings.evidence: Graph census/compile logs record one-hot status, but lowering erases Hotmux identity in emitted certificate. Graph helper asserts dense pins before adapter validates them.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Carry native-proved/deferred/refuted status and origin into export diagnostics/sidecar; prove values independently of one-hot assumptions. Prevalidate malformed layouts and require structured refusal rather than assertion abort.

findings.title: Historical plan text misstates current implementation
findings.evidence: Header still describes uncreated PR branch and monolithic legacy emitter. R1/R10 describe D4 as Lean-only, auto-moving FP pin and content-free Lean module moves.
findings.required_validation_or_action: Mark original phases historical, retain evidence, and use current master migration gates. Include lean_format split, actual import/BUILD adaptations and dependency boundary checks.
